_notes: needs_product_images:true -> /edit with the real packshot + auto 'match precisely' clause. false -> text-to-image + auto 'do NOT show the product'. The brand prompt modifier is prepended to every prompt automatically; just describe the scene. chain_from reuses an earlier image's output as an extra reference for visual consistency.

prompts.name: hero-packshot-on-marble
prompts.prompt: Create a premium hero packshot: the foundation bottle standing upright on a cream marble surface, a soft swatch of white cream beside its base, fresh out-of-focus botanical sprig in the background, soft morning light, lots of negative space above for headline copy.

prompts.name: in-hand-ugc
prompts.prompt: Create an authentic UGC-style vertical shot: a young woman's hand (mid-20s, natural skin) holding the bottle up near her face in soft window light at home, slightly imperfect phone-camera feel, relatable bathroom-counter setting blurred behind.

prompts.name: lifestyle-morning-routine
prompts.prompt: Create an aspirational lifestyle scene: a relaxed woman in her late 20s with glowing, even, natural skin smiling softly by a sunlit window, morning skincare-routine mood, warm neutral bathroom. Focus entirely on her radiant complexion and the calm mood.

prompts.name: lifestyle-story-version
prompts.prompt: Vertical story crop of the same scene and same woman — match the exact model, styling, lighting and colour grade from the reference image. Reframe for a 9:16 composition with headroom at the top for text.
